Hello, Abuja

Our kitchen is hot and ready — around the clock, every single day.

Jhansi started as a simple promise: you shouldn't have to leave the house to eat well. What began as a small online kitchen has grown into one of Abuja's most-followed food accounts — a full menu of Nigerian classics, continental comfort food, shawarma, cocktails, and bulk "Big Man Bowls" for the crowd, all cooked to order and delivered to your door.

No storefront to visit, no queue to join. Just a call, a DM, and a rider on the way — 24 hours a day, seven days a week, anywhere in Abuja.
